posts.en:
pdf-background-gray-codex-skill#dsh-pdf-background-gray is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Registers the remove-pdf-background-gray skill for DSH: whitens gray/off-white scan backgrounds in image-based PDFs while preserving resolution, page geometry, and anti-aliased text edges (lossless Flate write-back), via a single Python script (pypdf + Pillow + numpy).

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-05c70255b10569cfe136.html
